divisionCards.title: LANDSCAPE LIGHTING
divisionCards.body: Custom lighting designed around your home's architecture, landscaping, palms, pathways, pools and outdoor spaces.

soffitLightingBridge.headline: ARCHITECTURAL SOFFIT LIGHTING
soffitLightingBridge.body: Premium line-voltage recessed lighting installed in your home's soffit by our electrical division — a polished, code-correct alternative to bolt-on landscape fixtures.

landscapeOverview.headline: YOUR HOME SHOULDN'T DISAPPEAR AFTER DARK.
body: The right outdoor lighting completely changes the way your property looks and feels at night.
We design custom lighting systems around the architecture, landscaping and outdoor living spaces of each property to create depth, atmosphere, visibility and dramatic nighttime curb appeal.
Every property is different.
Every lighting design should be too.

permanentLighting.headline:
PERMANENT LIGHTING.
ENDLESS POSSIBILITIES.
body: Enjoy professionally installed permanent exterior lighting without hanging and removing lights every year.
Permanent lighting can provide everything from subtle warm-white architectural accents to vibrant customized colors for holidays and special occasions.
Designed to blend into your home's exterior during the day and completely transform it at night.

beforeAfterTeaser.headline: SEE YOUR HOME IN A WHOLE NEW LIGHT.

whyFarrell.headline:
PREMIUM LIGHTING.
BACKED BY ELECTRICAL EXPERIENCE SINCE 1980.
body: Farrell Electric, established in 1993, has served South Florida for more than three decades.
Our lighting services combine modern outdoor lighting design with over four decades of real electrical contracting experience dating back to 1980.
Customers shouldn't have to choose between an experienced electrical company and a premium lighting company.
With Farrell Electric, you get both.

process.title: PROPERTY CONSULTATION
process.body: We meet at the property, walk the exterior and discuss the look and atmosphere you're trying to create.

process.title: CUSTOM LIGHTING DESIGN
process.body: Fixture locations and lighting effects are planned around your home's architecture, landscaping and outdoor spaces.

process.title: CLEAR PROJECT ESTIMATE
process.body: You'll receive a proposal outlining the recommended lighting system and project scope.

process.title: PROFESSIONAL INSTALLATION

process.title: NIGHTTIME ADJUSTMENTS

electrical-services.headline: ELECTRICAL EXPERIENCE YOU CAN COUNT ON.
body: Since establishing the company in 1993, Farrell Electric has provided electrical services throughout South Florida for residential and commercial customers.
Whether the job involves troubleshooting, service, repairs, upgrades, lighting or larger electrical projects, we bring electrical experience dating back to 1980 to every project.

residential-electrician.headline: RESIDENTIAL ELECTRICAL
body: Electrical services for homes, renovations and property improvements.

commercial-electrician.headline: COMMERCIAL ELECTRICAL SOLUTIONS.
body: Farrell Electric provides electrical service for businesses, commercial properties, contractors and property managers throughout South Florida.

From troubleshooting and maintenance to lighting, renovations, upgrades and larger electrical projects, our goal is to provide dependable electrical solutions while minimizing disruption to the property.

about.headline: SERVING SOUTH FLORIDA SINCE 1993.
body: Farrell Electric, Inc. was established and opened its doors in South Florida in 1993.
The company's electrical experience dates back even further, to 1980, and for more than three decades Farrell Electric has served residential and commercial properties across South Florida.
Today, Farrell Electric continues to provide traditional electrical contracting services while expanding its focus on custom landscape lighting and permanent exterior lighting.
The goal is to combine over four decades of electrical experience with a modern approach to outdoor lighting design.
We're not trying to become another company that simply installs lights.
We're bringing the credibility and technical experience of an established electrical contractor into the premium outdoor lighting space.
